title: Niyama
description: Cultivate inner purity and contentment through the five personal observances that create a stable environment for spiritual growth.

sutra.meaning: Yama (moral injunctions), Niyama (observances), Āsana (posture), Prāṇāyāma (regulation of breath), Pratyāhāra (withholding of senses), Dhāraṇā (fixity of attention), Dhyāna (meditation), and Samādhi (absorption of consciousness in the self) are the eight accessories (limbs) of Yoga

sections.practice: attempt to take up one new practice or change in lifestyle in accordance with yamas and niyamas
sections.gurudevInsight: The husk is gone, the sprout moves though it & comes up. They are (1) Yama (2) Niyama (3) Aasana (4) Pranayama (5) Pratyahara (6) Dhyana (7) Dharana (8) Samadhi. He goes into the details of each & what is the result that you can expect from each one of them. Yoga has 8 limbs, like a chair has got four legs, yoga has 8 limbs, or legs. So you just pull 80 one, everything else will come down. If you pull one leg of the chair whole chair comes. [PDF p.80]

sutra.meaning: Cleanliness, contentment, discipline, self-study, surrender, these fixed observances refine inner life.

sections.insight: There is always scope for improvement in following all of these Niyamas
sections.reflectionPrompt: Which one needs special attention from me?
sections.practice: Focus on one at a time. Which one is particularly challenging for me.
sections.journalPrompt: What changes was I inspired to make in my life?
sections.gurudevInsight: It simply doesn’t register in their consciousness. Keeping personal hygiene in very essential; shaucha & Mind also clean – antahshaucha bhaayabrantarashaucha – outer cleanliness & inner cleanliness, mind being free from tensions. b) Santosha: - Contentment, happiness, happiness again is an attitude. If you are used to be unhappy in best of situations you’ll still grumble & be unhappy. You know, you did this exercise this morning keeping a smile & breathing & just enjoy your breath. See, when you are happy, what is happening? [PDF p.87]

sutra.meaning: There may be doubts about the claims of yoga made in this text of Sri Patanjali and made in other yoga books, however one should cast these doubts aside and practice. When the doubts arise, one should ignore the doubtful ideas and push ahead with practice.

sections.insight: In the case of the annoyance produced by doubts, one should conceive of what is opposite.
sections.reflectionPrompt: Do doubts arise in me regarding the sutras?
sections.practice: Dont let doubts affect your practice.
sections.journalPrompt: What doubts I have encountered during my practices.
sections.gurudevInsight: Freedom comes with viveka or discrimination. All other species in this creation are governed by nature, totally, they don’t need discrimination nor do they have freedom. Human consciousness, human mind have this possibility of freedom, has been given freedom so it is also given discrimination. It is through this viveka, wisdom, discrimination that a human mind, human consciousness can be governed to progress or to remain where it is. You will not find any animal over eating, generally. If they are sick or perverted, they may do anything. [PDF p.80]

sections.theme: Purity is respect for the body.

sutra.meaning: Purity leads to respect for body and mind

sections.reflectionPrompt: Negative and unclean thoughts have an impact on how you feel and see yourself.
sections.gurudevInsight: Before mentioning this, he also mentioned the niyamas, what are the niyamas? sauchasantoshatapasswadhayaishwarapranidhana niyama 86 a) Shaucha b) Santosha c) Tapas d) Swadhaya e) Ishwara Pranidhana a) Shaucha: - Purity, physical purity. People, who don’t take bath for several days, just put on the perfumes, this is no cleanliness. Water should run through this body, both inside & outside, you have to drink enough water & let water run through this system. Water is greatest purifier of this physical body. Cleanliness in the atmosphere, in the environment. [PDF p.86]

sections.theme: A clean mind opens to the infinite.

sutra.meaning: Purification of the psyche results in benevolence, the ability of one pointed attention, control of  sensual energy, awareness of the consciousness and ability of abstract meditation.

sections.insight: When the body is cleansed, the mind purified and the senses controlled , joyful awareness required to realize the inner self also comes.
sections.reflectionPrompt: Do I maintain hygiene and feel clean?
sections.practice: Maintain cleanliness in body and mind.
sections.journalPrompt: Did I make any lifestyle changes.
sections.gurudevInsight: Shaucha-cleanliness establishes what satva should be. The mind becomes satvic, the brain becomes the buddhi, the intellent gets purified, saumnyata - mind becomes even & harmonious, ekagrata - one pointededness, indriyajayatva - say over ones sense organs, atmadarshanyogyavaani - ability to realize one Self comes to you by purity. When you are very unhappy or depressed, for sometime not being in contact with anybody. This is a very natural inbuilt thing in our system, you know. When you feel very unpleasant, depressed, you want to shut away from everybody and just remain with your Self, isn’t it? Non-contact with anyone else can bring certain amount of purity in you. [PDF p.90]

sutra.meaning: From contentment, the very best in happiness is obtained.

sections.theme: Fire burns what no longer serves.

sutra.meaning: Austerity, resulting in the elimination of impurity produces perfection of the body and sensual energy.

sections.insight: Self-discipline (tapas) burns away impurities and kindles the sparks of Divinity.
sections.reflectionPrompt: Is maintaining discipline a problem for me.
sections.practice: Make a note of areas of your life which need you to be disciplined. Can you commit to yourself to make an effort in the area/s.
sections.journalPrompt: Did the commitment seem like a burden or serve as an inspiration.
sections.gurudevInsight: A person who is always small minded, always looking at who is good looking? You will see his energy is so low, so dull & nobody goes nearby that sort of person. Person who is obsessed with sex is so unattractive, isn’t it? & He creates such a dull & thick vibration around him or her that there is no strength, there is no vigor, there is no commitment, nothing comes out of them, have you notice this? If you have not noticed, see in all those places in Bars etc. you can find them here & there in one of the streets, such a thick, lust loaded minds & they have no strength at all. [PDF p.85]

sutra.meaning: From study of our own psyche, comes intimate contact with the cherished divine being.

sections.insight: asana and pranayama are integral to connecting awareness of the body with core and vice versa
sections.reflectionPrompt: Can I commit to my daily practice or kriya
sections.practice: Practice asana and pranayam with complete focus inward.

sections.gurudevInsight: ashudhishaya - the impurities are eliminated. Swadhayaistdevata samayanta -By self study (Swadhyaya) the deva, the divine presence are felt. By observing, by being hollow & empty you become a channel, you become a part of the Divine, you’ve able to feel the presence of the Divinity, all different angels & the Devas, all these different forms of our consciousness starts blossoming. samadhisiddhiishwarapranidhana - By one pointed devotion to the Divine, Samadhi comes about. 3) Aasana: - Sthiramsukhamasana - That which is steady & which is comfortable is the asana. [PDF p.91]

sutra.meaning: From  profound  meditation upon the Divine comes the perfection of continuous effortless linkage of the attention to that Divinity.

sections.insight: The power of samadhi comes to him who takes refuge in the Divine.
sections.reflectionPrompt: Surrender to God brings perfection in samadhi. Can I surrender to the Divine?
sections.practice: sit for meditation with the intention of total surrender
sections.gurudevInsight: People steal many things, someone else’s poem, some one elect techniques, things. The effect of non-stealing, if you are committed to be sincere, non-stealing – sarvaratnopalapati - all the wealth comes to you effortlessly, all the wealth comes to you. A little intention to steal can keep you poor. A person wants to be sneaky & try to get, grab as much as he can, that is where his luck goes down the drain. Brahmacharayapratisthayam veeryalaabha d) Brahmacharya: - Said as Celibacy. Celibacy brings you strength; a lot of strength but Brahmacharya has a deeper or bigger meaning than just celibacy. [PDF p.84]
